name: Wide-angle colour camera
blurb: Daily global snapshots of weather and clouds. Cheap and light.
heritage: MARCI on MRO; JunoCam on Juno

name: Context camera
blurb: Medium-resolution black-and-white mapping camera — the workhorse of planetary geology.

name: High-resolution telescope camera
blurb: Sees objects the size of a kitchen table from orbit. Heavy, power-hungry and a data firehose.

name: Imaging spectrometer (visible–infrared)
blurb: Splits light into hundreds of colours to identify minerals and ices.
heritage: CRISM on MRO; Moon Mineralogy Mapper

name: Gamma-ray & neutron spectrometer
blurb: Detects hydrogen — and therefore water ice — hidden under the surface.
heritage: Lunar Prospector GRS/NS; GRaND on Dawn

name: Shallow radar sounder
blurb: Radar pulses that see layers of ice and rock hundreds of metres down.

name: Laser altimeter
blurb: Fires laser pulses at the ground to build precise 3-D maps.
heritage: LOLA on LRO; MOLA on Mars Global Surveyor

name: Thermal infrared radiometer
blurb: Measures temperatures — down to the coldest places in the solar system.
heritage: Diviner on LRO; MCS on MRO

name: Magnetometer on a boom
blurb: Maps magnetic fields — clues to a planet's core and its lost atmosphere.

name: Plasma & energetic particle suite
blurb: Counts the charged particles of the solar wind and radiation belts.
heritage: SWIA/SEP on MAVEN; JADE/JEDI on Juno

name: Neutral gas & ion mass spectrometer
blurb: Sniffs the upper atmosphere molecule by molecule.

name: Ultraviolet imaging spectrograph
blurb: Watches auroras and the glowing upper atmosphere.
heritage: IUVS on MAVEN; UVS on Juno

name: Microwave radiometer
blurb: Sees hundreds of kilometres down into a giant planet's clouds to measure water.

name: Ka-band radio science package
blurb: Uses your own radio signal's Doppler shift to weigh the planet's interior. Needs Ka-band comms.
notes: Engine rule: quality 0 unless design.commsBand = Ka.
